When Chefs Molly and Gil bring their tasty food truck to Bland Land, they discover that Baron von Bland only lets his subjects eat Bland Bread; the Chefs must find a way to bring taste to the kingdom.

The Bubble Guppies learn about construction while building a doghouse for Bubble Puppy.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

In the Gourmet Galaxy, everyone loves yummy food, but when Gen. Yuck turns everything icky, only a recipe for delicious moon muffins can stop her; master chef Goby and his apprentice, Deema, must bake those muffins and save the galaxy.

title: Team Umizoomi
description:
S04 E14 — Umi Knights
Milli, Geo and Bot are UmiKnights who must save the kingdom by helping a dragon find his glasses.

title: Team Umizoomi
description:

The team must help Sophia complete her butterfly costume before the Butterfly Dance Show.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

Liberty and the Poms team up with the Mighty Pups to save Adventure Bay from being crushed by a giant, flying Top Hat.

description:

Mayor Humdinger swipes Francois' water-walking shoes and ends up trapped in a pit-like turtle nest; the pups spring into action when a nearby volcano erupts.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E25 — Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save a Runaway Stargazer
A comet is coming, and the PAW Patrol gets to work building a giant observatory; when the observatory starts rolling out of control, Rubble and the pups need to rebuild everything it has destroyed.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S05 E07 — The Crew Builds an Underwater Shell Museum; The Crew Builds a Giant Shoe Store
Wheeler discovers a giant ancient shell deep in a cave, but when the pups try to dig it out, the cave almost collapses; the pups have to save Wheeler when ducks take him for a wild ride on Shopkeeper Shelley's giant shoe-shaped shoe store!

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S01 E12 — The Crew Does a Home Renovation; The Crew Builds a Lighthouse
Mix and Rubble are starstruck when their favorite TV renovation star, Hank Hammer, comes to see them at work; Cap'n Turbot is bringing Mayor Goodway to visit her sister, Mayor Greatway; when a fog rolls in, the pups must build a lighthouse quickly.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E19 — Pups Save Queen Cluck-Cluck; Pups Save a Desert Flounder
Mayor Goodway dreams she's traveled to the mysterious Cluck Cluck Island, a very strange land where Chickaletta is royalty; Traveling Travis' balloon gets caught on the Flounder.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S12 E10 — Pups Save a Big Brother; Pups Save a Giant Baby
Farmer Yumi dreams about what her new baby will be like when she's bigger.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E22 — Pups Save a Floundering Francois; Pups Save the Pop-Up Penguins
Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are watching white whales in Adventure Bay when their boat hits a rock and starts to sink; the PAW Patrol must track down some loose penguins and help them return to the land of ice and snow.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E12 — Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Meet the Mighty Twins
When bandit Ladybird shrieks havoc in Adventure Bay and takes all the town's treasures, the Mighty Pups team up with new super pals, the Mighty Twins, to save the day -- and Mayor Goodway.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

When a baby caribou winds up speeding down a mountainside, it's up to the PAW Patrol to save the calf and reunite it with its family; when Luke Stars gets blown away in a giant tumbleweed, Digi and Tal make a duplicate which dances out of control.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E13 — Pups Save the Big Book Delivery; Pups Save the Puppets
Mayor Humdinger's kitties make off with Mayor Goodway's book delivery truck; Julius and Julia get into a sticky situation when the paper bag puppets they created for a puppet show become stuck on the antlers of a deer.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E05 — Winter Sports Chompetition!
Gil and Bubble Puppy are competing in the Winter Sports Chompetition, a competition for athletes and their dogs; they hope to stop reigning champs Coldsnap and his dog Mr. Husky from cheating to win the gold.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E17 — Happy Clam Day!
The Bubble Guppies have to learn about the mail so they can send invitations to a party for Clam.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E14 — Boy Meets Squirrel
The Bubble Guppies learn about trees.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

The Mayor gets a tummy ache while training for Bubbletucky's annual marathon and has to go to the hospital to get checked out.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

The Bubble Guppies must deal with a difficult customer at their restaurant.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

The Guppies are excited for China's Lunar New Year Festival, where they will operate a giant festival dragon in the grand parade.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

Goby must retrace his steps to find his lost toy at a construction site.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

On the U.S.S. Recycler, Captain Deema and her crew strive to leave every planet cleaner than they found it; however, their mission is put to the test when a crew of messy Litterbugs, led by the evil Garbage Khan, take over their ship.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E04 — The Good, the Sad, and the Grumpy!
When Mr. Grumpfish turns up in Happy Junction, he makes everyone in town really grumpy; Sheriff Molly must find a way to help everyone handle their tricky emotions.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E08 — A Furry Tale!
Hansel and Gretel have to get Bubble Puppy and Bubble Kitty home safe to the Furry Godmother, but they're being stalked by a witch.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E14 — The Big Rig Bandit!
When reckless hyena Spotty steals young elephant Eli from the savanna, Wildlife Rangers Zooli and Goby hop into their big rig to rescue him; when the big rig chase lands Spotty and Eli in danger, it's up to the Guppies to save the day.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E09 — We Totally Rock!
The Bubble Guppies take the stage and learn about rock music.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E18 — Puppy Girl and Super Pup!
When supervillain Felina Meow starts turning all the dogs at the annual dog show into cats, it's up to superheroes Puppy Girl and Super Pup to stop her.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S04 E06 — Temple of the Lost Puppy!
When Bubble Puppy disappears after biting an ancient magic bone, the Guppies must embark on an adventure to find him.

The heroic rescue pups, led by a tech-savvy boy named Ryder work together to protect the community; geared with special skills, gadgets and vehicles that help them on their rescue missions, the PAW Patrol is always up for the challenge.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S05 E09 — The Crew Fixes A Blocked Pipe/The Crew Builds A Construction Basketball Show
The pups enlist a kitten named Marble to go inside a pipe and fix the blockage; when a traveling basketball team fails to show up, the construction pups gear up and put on their own basketball show.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

At the Farm Fair, a mysterious critter chews up everything in sight, and the pups must save the day; Rocky dreams a sudsy accident turns Adventure Bay into a giant bubble bath, putting everyone at risk!

title: Deer Squad
description:

Baron Bite creates a slushy ice cloud that brings the blizzard to Platinum City; a game of Wild West gets out of control when Cowboy Steel's Robo Pony and special suit get wet.

description:

The Great Egg Hunt begins, and Blaze and Crusher race all over town to see who can find the most eggs; only the first truck to collect 100 eggs will win the egg-ceptionally tasty chocolate trophy.

Tracker and Lucita Buena call on the Air Rescue Pups to help save an irreplaceable Mother Tree; it's then up to the Paw Patrol to fix Mr. Porter's ice cream freezer before everything melts!

title: PAW Patrol
description:

After Danny's baseball accident, Digi and Tal create a safety suit for him to wear, designed to protect him from danger; Francois' fancy fromage goes missing before the competition, so he enlists Squeak the mouse to lead the rescue.

title: The Marsupilamis
description:
Musical Mayhem; Purrfect Punch
Three energetic Marsupilamis leave their jungle world for the city where mystery and excitement await as they bond with twins eager to protect their extraordinary friends.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

Vanessa Pressley is on Dino Island to film her new dino documentary; she and the cameraman get carried off by a Brachiosaurus; when Daring Danny X's dino-stunt goes awry, he winds up with a grouchy Spinosaurus on his trail!

title: Rubble & Crew
description:

description:

After stowing away on the Turbots' camping trip, Wally the walrus gets stuck in a mountain crevasse, and it's up to Everest and the PAW Patrol to rescue him; Mayor Humdinger challenges Rubble for the right to deejay a dance party.

description:

Peppa and friends try to decide what they might like to be when they grow up; in the playgroup, there are nurses, police officers, and even pirates.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E26 — Pups and the Pirate Treasure
Cap'n Turbot stumbles into a secret cavern that was once a pirate's hideout; the PAW Patrol searches for clues to find the missing pieces of a treasure map.

description:
S07 E01 — Mighty Pups Charged Up: Pups Stop a Humdinger Horde; Mighty Pups Charged Up: Pups Save a Mighty Lighthouse
The Mighty Pups have to save the day when Harold makes a cloning machine; Harold uses his superpowers to turn Cap'n Turbot's lighthouse into a rocket.
